preconditions.description: The table dimensions n and m are integers between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) == m for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the n lines in the table has exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'D', 'I', 'M', 'A'} for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for c in line)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the table contains exactly one of the characters 'D', 'I', 'M', or 'A'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Poor Dima!' if not any('D' in line for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) else None
postconditions.description: If there are no 'D' cells in the table, output 'Poor Dima!' (no traversal possible).

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Poor Inna!' if any(cycle_exists(grid) for grid in possible_cycles) else None
postconditions.description: If there exists a cycle of length 4 (D-I-M-A-D) in the table, output 'Poor Inna!' (infinite traversals possible).

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(max_count) if not any(cycle_exists(grid) for grid in possible_cycles) and any('D' in line for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) else None
postconditions.description: If no infinite cycle exists but at least one traversal is possible, output the maximum number of times Inna can traverse 'DIMA'.
